title: Mesmerizing
text: Mesmerizing. Absolutely love mine! It's on my desk at work and even my staff love spinning it. 😁 I also purchased one for my sister as a gift. It's mesmerizing and beautiful. Very happy I bought it!

product_metadata.title: Atellani Square Wave Horizon | Handcrafted in Italy, Kinetic Sculpture Desktop in Stainless Steel, Cool Desk Gadgets and Physics Gifts, Desk Toys for Adults, Magical Calming Art Piece by Ivan Black
features: Handmade in Italy - Designed by the award winning British artist Ivan Black. Each Horizon is handcrafted by skilled artisans, our sculpture can truly claim to be made in Italy
Stand Included - Our new stand is designed to keep your Square Wave in place at both ends so it can turn on its side with precision, creating the perfect spin, every time
Quality Made To Endure - Square Wave Horizon is designed with quality and attention to detail in mind, every facet of our production process is perfected to create beautiful works of art
Luxurious Packaging - We take every detail of production into consideration, this is why we spent months developing our packaging, to create the perfect gift box

Stress Relieving Waves - Square Wave Horizon is perfect for those moments when you’re going through a hard day and need something to ground yourself. Take a look at and interact with Horizon to immediately unwind and let stress go
